centroid_jitter_px.definition: standard deviation of the frame-to-frame subject centroid step, excluding declared discontinuities

scale_drift.definition: RELATIVE drift: |tracker first-to-last area ratio / ground-truth area ratio - 1|. Relative drift normalises error by true growth; absolute ratio difference is a different metric and needs a different threshold.

mean_interframe_ssim.definition: Source-clip mean of every adjacent SSIM pair; static backgrounds can hide local defects.

discontinuity.note: Two-frame displacement at frames100/101; transitions enter100 and return102. Only tracking-config.excluded_transition_frames controls jitter exclusion.

verdict_note: Jitter/drift are tracker-specific; SSIM is clip-level. Use truth IoU and visual review to distinguish tracker failures from clip defects.
